findings.contract: Registration requires an existing ECS service and new min/max capacities; capacities zero are accepted. Syntactically valid nonexistent IAM RoleARN is ignored in favor of the ECS Application Auto Scaling linked role; malformed RoleARN is rejected.
Target updates retain ARN and CreationTime. Omitted/null fields preserve values; partial SuspendedState merges booleans and empty object is a no-op. Describe materializes all three suspension flags.

Register Tags on an existing target is rejected; empty Tags is rejected. TagResource merges/overwrites keys; UntagResource ignores missing keys but rejects null/empty key arrays. Deleted or nonexistent target tag ARN returns ResourceNotFoundException, distinct from target-control ObjectNotFoundException.

Policy Describe preserves optional-field absence rather than materializing documented cooldown, aggregation or disable-scale-in defaults. Whole StepScalingPolicyConfiguration omitted/null preserves all fields. Supplied object preserves absent AdjustmentType/StepAdjustments but replaces optional Cooldown/MetricAggregationType/MinAdjustmentMagnitude, including clearing them when omitted.

Target tracking partial update retains omitted metric specification; resupplying minimal configuration clears omitted optional cooldown and DisableScaleIn fields. Policy ARN and CreationTime are stable across updates. Step/non-step type changes and simultaneous configuration families are rejected.

CPU target50 managed alarms use AWS/ECS CPUUtilization Average, ClusterName/ServiceName dimensions, high threshold50 GreaterThanThreshold for 3x60s, low threshold45 LessThanThreshold for 15x60s. DatapointsToAlarm and TreatMissingData are absent. Disabling scale-in removes low alarm. AlarmActions include the policy ARN suffixed with :createdBy/<uuid>.
ForecastOnly predictive CPU metric-pair policy is admitted without alarms. No predictive forecast or dynamic behavior was exercised.

ScheduledAction updates preserve ARN, CreationTime, omitted/null Schedule and Timezone, and omitted/null action. Omitting StartTime/EndTime clears them. A nonempty action object replaces previous capacities; an empty object is rejected. Default Timezone is absent in Describe.

Native schedule grammar accepts rate(1 days) and past at expressions. Five-field cron, simultaneous day-of-month/day-of-week, nonexistent calendar date, invalid timezone, empty timezone, zero rate and reversed start/end are rejected. All admitted action capacities in this capture are zero.

MaxResults truncates results, including zero returning no policies. Captured responses omit NextToken even when more matching resources exist; invalid supplied tokens are rejected. The documented 1..50 bounds were not enforced for tested 0 and 51 cases. Policy/action name/type filtering works; ScalableDimension without ResourceId is rejected by policy/action describes.

Deregister deletes associated policies and scheduled actions, invalidates tag ARN, and repeated deregister errors. Reregistration generates a new target ARN/CreationTime. Deleting the ECS service removed its target; recreating the ECS service name did not recreate its target.

Pre-existing linked role trusts ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com and has no Description member in GetRole. Its attached AWSApplicationAutoscalingECSServicePolicy default version v3 contains the exact native ECS/CloudWatch authority; no inline policy exists. No linked-role mutation was performed.

uncertainties: This is zero-capacity ECS replica control/admission evidence, not scaling-runtime evidence. No metrics were published, no task was launched, no other namespace behavior or account quota exhaustion was probed.

Raw signed helper returns status/body only, not response headers. Native raw JSON field presence/order/errors and HTTP status are retained; request IDs unavailable through that helper are not synthesized. AWS CLI success timestamps are its native JSON representation.

Pagination continuation could not be exercised: MaxResults-limited native responses contained no NextToken despite multiple matching objects. Do not generalize token encoding or stable cross-page order from these observations.
Namespace/dimension mismatch returned AccessDeniedException in this account, so semantic validation order beyond that authorization boundary is unresolved.

Predictive policy admission was ForecastOnly; forecasts, training/history requirements, and predictive execution were not probed. Invalid policy-type native error lists RightSizing, but that undocumented type was not exercised.

The three task-definition revisions were deregistered and accepted for deletion; final native status remains DELETE_IN_PROGRESS. All associated services/clusters are deleted/inactive and all task lists empty. AWS asynchronous task-definition tombstone removal timing is unresolved.

The preliminary capture stopped on expected-success assertion after a role-validation probe unexpectedly registered a target. Its complete native calls and successful owned-resource cleanup are retained in preliminaryCapture; the full main capture used a fresh owned prefix.

The focused follow-up used two zero-task EC2/bridge replica services in a distinct owned cluster with no container instances or networking to isolate policy merge and multi-target pagination. No EC2 instances were created.
